verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's own pages document in-product AI that works from account data. The pricing page lists "Get answers from your data." Composer builds the audience, drafts content, maps out a send strategy and proposes changes for your review. K:AI picks the best-performing channel per message, and there is an AI subject line generator. The MCP server is excluded because it works outside the Klaviyo interface. missing for 10: in-depth docs on what data insights or answers are generated in-app (e.g. anomaly detection, performance explanations), and independent or hands-on corroboration, since the evidence is only short marketing claims.
